body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> While a great number of products over 30 different categories were presented during CES 2007, one of the products that drew attention of visitors was either pc that could be used as TV or TV that could be used as pc.

iMon Ultra Bay, designed by Soundgraph of Korea, was a good example; Being composed of a hardware with 7-infh front display and software, it is a practical solution that transforms your general pc into a convenient home media center pc.
(Picture: if users install the iMon Ultra Bay to a general desktop pc, they can take full control of their pc with a remote control)
Interesting thing to note about the iMon is that the company invented this model in year 2001 even before MS’ Media Center Edition came to market.

The software includes neat and easy-to-use simple graphic user interface; so the iMon has been gaining popularity among adults that are not familiar with computers or those that want to get excitement of home theater system in a more convenient environment without costly investment to their existing computing system.

Meanwhile, its hardware with 7-inch front display received favorable response in the industry in terms of stable operation capability on Window Vista environment, so, many pc-case manufacturing companies have adopted the model into their products according to Soundgraph.
